title: System CPU Entity
description: Defines bare-metal/VM CPU requirements: core count, architecture, affinity. Tools translate to OS-specific mechanisms.

architecture.description: CPU architecture (e.g., x86_64, aarch64, armv7l, riscv64).

cpuset.description: CPU affinity pinning (e.g., "0-3", "0,1"). Restricts to specific cores.

governor.description: CPU frequency governor (e.g., performance, powersave, ondemand, conservative).
